extraction: Verification loop commands: verify-phase1 (lint/typecheck), verify-phase2 (unit tests), verify-phase3 (integration), verify-phase4 (regression), verify-all (all phases), verify-watch (continuous). Maps to our Engine: verify-all in CI. verify-watch during development. Verdict runs verify-phase2 + verify-phase3 during review. Miss runs verify-phase1 + verify-phase2 after patch. Commands configurable per project (ruff, mypy, pytest, custom integration).
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether verification-loop CLI commands integrated into Engine/Miss/Verdict workflows
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
